3b1(dus 'khor): shes lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas//khengs dang longs spyod 'byor pa du ma btang nas sems ni bla mar gtad byas te//sangs rgyas nyid kyi slad du gtso bo'i 'grel bshad gzhan phan spyod pa mnyan par bya//mngon shes med gang dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa la

3b4(dus 'khor): sems drangs shing //dpal ldan shes rab bde nyams rdo rje'i tshig bcom phyi yi longs spyod dag gis zil mnan pa'o//gang zhig ston pa nyid kyis lung bstan rgyal ba dag bde ster rdo rje theg par mtha' dag ni//'grel bshad dag dang bsdu ba mdzad pa rdo rje mchog 
3b5(dus 'khor): 'dzin bdag 'dra'i byang chub sems dpa' ste//de dag 'dir ni lha dang lag 'gro mi rnams smin pa'i don du sangs rgyas mthur smra la//gang dag mngon shes lnga med de dag bdag cag rgyal dbang yin zhes bden pa min pa smra//ma 'ongs dus na rtag tu rtog ge la sogs bstan

4a1(dus 'khor): @#//la ni dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i 'grel bshad rtag tu mnyan pa ste//shes rab rlung gi dar gyis myur 'gro myang 'das pha rol don gnyer chen po rnams//dam pa'i bde bas myur du rgal bar byed slad de ni lam gyi 'dren ma dang //nyon mongs bdud tshogs
